name: Denominations
overview: Scripture emphasizes the unity of the church as essential, warning that division leads to destruction, as Jesus taught that a kingdom divided against itself cannot stand (Matthew 12:25). The church is built on the foundation of Christ, the true Rock, ensuring its endurance despite opposition (Matthew 16:18). While believers are many members with distinct roles within one body (Romans 12:4), divisions that contradict sound doctrine must be identified and avoided to preserve the church’s purity (Romans 16:17). Salvation is secured through faith and baptism, underscoring the centrality of belief in Christ amid denominational differences (Mark 16:16), and Jesus prayed for all who would believe through His followers’ message, highlighting the call for unity in faith (John 17:20).
